name: Heavy Process Equipment — Crushers, Mills, Kilns, Dust Collection & Mixers

work_packages.wp: Heavy foundation / pier / mill sole-plate acceptance
work_packages.note: Massive dynamic foundations; embedded soleplates for mills/crushers; kiln pier survey and roller-station level
Multi-piece assembly (mill shell, trunnions, gear, kiln shell sections); big-lift rig plans
Kiln roller/tyre alignment, mill trunnion/gear mesh, crusher shaft; epoxy grouting of soleplates
Girth gear/pinion mesh, main drive, lube/hydraulic sets, wear liners, refractory (kilns)
Baghouse/cyclone, ducting, feed/discharge chutes, conveyor interfaces
HV/MV drive, VFD, vibration/temperature/speed protection, interlocked start sequence

activities: Accept dynamic foundation/piers at strength with embedded soleplates surveyed
Kiln pier and roller-station level/alignment datum established
Confirm anchor/embed pattern for mill/crusher/mixer bases
sequence.note: These are dynamic, high-load machines — foundation mass, level and embed accuracy are safety-critical

activities: Offload and stage heavy components
Assemble multi-piece equipment (mill shell + trunnions, kiln shell sections, crusher frame)
Set on soleplates/roller stations per rig plan
sequence.note: Field assembly of large mills/kilns is a major sub-sequence in itself

activities: Kiln: align roller stations, set tyre/roller contact and slope; Mill: set trunnion bearings level and girth-gear/pinion backlash & root clearance; Crusher: set main shaft/eccentric
Epoxy grout soleplates; cure
Final anchor torque and re-check alignment
Install wear liners; install/dry refractory for kilns
sequence.note: Gear mesh (backlash + contact pattern) and kiln roller alignment are precision, safety-critical steps; refractory dry-out is a controlled heating curve

activities: Connect lube/hydraulic/cooling/spray-water piping
Connect process/utility lines (water, air, gas/fuel for kilns)
Fit dust-collection ducting, chutes and material tie-ins
sequence.note: Fuel/gas piping for kilns/dryers is a hazardous-service interface with its own testing

activities: Terminate main HV/MV drive and any inching/barring drive
Land vibration, bearing/gear temperature, speed and position protection
Earth/bond frame and structure
Connect dust-collector controls, dampers and cleaning system
sequence.note: Barring/inching drive lets the machine be turned slowly for checks and refractory dry-out

activities: Alignment, gear-mesh contact pattern and clearance records
Lube system, liner and refractory sign-off
Mechanical completion walkdown
Lube/hydraulic system flush to cleanliness spec
Ducting leak/flow test; baghouse pressure-drop and cleaning-cycle test
Protection loop-check and trip test
Barring/inching run then solo no-load drive run
sequence.note: No-load run checks bearings, gear temperature and vibration before any material or heat

activities: Refractory dry-out on controlled curve (kilns/dryers)
No-load run of the full drive train
Set lube pressures/temperatures, spray systems and dust-collection dampers
Calibrate feed/weigh and speed instruments
sequence.note: Refractory dry-out must follow the OEM heating curve or the lining spalls

activities: Introduce material / heat progressively
Ramp to rated throughput; tune drive, dust collection and process
Prove interlocks and emergency stops live
Performance/throughput acceptance run
sequence.note: Interlocked start/stop sequence with upstream/downstream conveyors is proven before material

typical_relationships.after: Setting and field assembly of the machine
typical_relationships.reason: Dynamic mills/kilns/crushers cannot be assembled true on an unsurveyed foundation
Grout fixes the alignment; it is placed only after the precision alignment is set and accepted

typical_relationships.before: Lube/hydraulic system flushed to cleanliness spec
typical_relationships.reason: Grinding gear and heavy bearings are destroyed by contaminated lube

typical_relationships.before: Refractory dry-out on the controlled curve
typical_relationships.after: Introducing process heat/material to a kiln or dryer
typical_relationships.reason: Firing green refractory hard spalls and cracks the lining

typical_relationships.before: No-load / barring run of the drive train
typical_relationships.reason: Bearings, gear temperature and vibration must be proven clean before the machine is loaded

typical_relationships.before: Interlocked start sequence and E-stops proven with upstream/downstream conveyors
typical_relationships.reason: Starting a crusher/mill out of sequence buries or damages equipment and endangers people
Environmental permits and worker safety require dust extraction live before dust-generating operation
Running a mill/crusher without liners wrecks the shell/frame

interfaces.requirement: Setting REQUIRES a dynamic foundation/piers at strength with embedded soleplates and a survey datum
Drive operation REQUIRES the HV/MV feeder and VFD terminated, tested and energised
First run REQUIRES vibration/temperature/speed protection looped and trips proven
Material commissioning REQUIRES upstream/downstream conveyors installed and the interlocked start/stop sequence proven
Kiln/dryer firing REQUIRES fuel/gas piping erected, tested and purged; grinding REQUIRES lube/hydraulic/spray-water piping connected and flushed
Dust-generating operation REQUIRES the dust-collection/baghouse and ducting commissioned
Automatic sequenced operation REQUIRES the plant control logic (start permissives, interlocks, trips) configured and proven
Energisation REQUIRES the machine frame and structure bonded to the earthing grid
Operation REQUIRES cooling water, instrument/plant air and any process gas headers live and clean

testing_requirements: Foundation soleplate survey and alignment datum records
Trunnion/roller-station alignment and kiln slope records
Girth-gear/pinion backlash, root clearance and contact-pattern check
Epoxy grout cure and anchor torque records
Ducting leak/flow test and baghouse pressure-drop / cleaning-cycle test
Protection loop-check and trip test (vibration, bearing/gear temp, speed)
Barring then no-load solo drive run with vibration and temperature baseline
Interlocked start-sequence and E-stop functional test
commissioning_dependencies: Precision alignment set, grouted, anchored and re-checked
Wear liners installed and refractory dried out on curve
HV/MV drive and VFD energised and tested
Protection and trip loops proven; E-stops functional
Upstream/downstream conveyors and interlocked sequence proven
Fuel/gas, cooling water and air utilities live and clean
No-load run completed clean before material/heat introduction
typical_exceptions: Smaller mixers/agitators may arrive assembled and need only mounting, coupling and a no-load run
Screens/vibrating equipment are spring-isolated and levelled on their mounts, not grouted
Electrically-heated dryers skip fuel-gas piping and use a different (electrical) dry-out
Cyclone-only dust separation has no baghouse cleaning-cycle test
evidence: The mill was fed material before the girth-gear mesh contact pattern was verified, the lube system was flushed, and the interlocked start sequence with the feed conveyors was proven; the kiln was fired before refractory dry-out on the OEM curve.
